brief.zh: 芽芽想记住一块电池的电量。给杯子贴上名字，存一个数，再把它读出来。
brief.en: Sprout wants to remember a battery’s charge. Give a cup a name, store a number, and read it back.

execution.source:
charge = scan()
say(str(charge))
saved = charge
charge = 0
say(str(saved))

title.zh: 芽芽怎么找到刚才的数？
title.en: How can Sprout find that number again?

body.zh: 把杯架想成一小片内存。杯位下的编号告诉你去哪里找，这就是模型里的地址。杯子上的名字告诉你要找哪个数，杯里的数字才是它的值。
body.en: Imagine this rack is a tiny piece of memory. A number under a spot tells you where to look. That is its address in this model. The name on a cup tells you which number to look up. The number inside is its value.

body.zh: 读 charge 就像透过杯壁看数字，读完数字还在。给 charge 赋值 0，下一次读到的就是 0。装着数字 0 的杯子里已经有一个值，空杯还没存过数。
body.en: Reading charge is like looking through the cup. Its number stays there. Assign 0 to charge and the next read gives you 0. A cup holding 0 already has a value. An empty cup has not been given one yet.

body.zh: saved = charge 让 saved 也记住此刻的电量。后来给 charge 赋新值，仍能用 saved 读出原来的数字。在 Python 里，变量是用来找到值的名字，实际内存位置由 Python 安排。
body.en: saved = charge gives the current number another name, saved. After charge is assigned a new value, you can still read the earlier number using saved. In Python a variable is a name for a value. Python manages the actual memory locations.

caption.zh: 杯位都编好了号，芽芽还没存入电量。
caption.en: Each spot has an address. Sprout has not stored a reading yet.

caption.zh: 把名字 charge 贴在 20 号杯，存入电量 3。读出 3 后，杯里的数还在。
caption.en: Label the cup at spot 20 charge and store 3. Reading 3 leaves the number in place.

caption.zh: 让 saved 记住 charge 当前的电量。现在用两个名字都能读到 3。
caption.en: Give the current reading the name saved as well. Both names now give you 3.

caption.zh: 把 charge 改成 0。杯位编号照旧，saved 还记得原来的 3。
caption.en: Set charge to 0. The addresses on the rack stay put, and saved still remembers 3.

prompt.zh: 18 号杯贴着 charge，里面装着 7。让芽芽读 charge，它会报出什么？
prompt.en: The cup at spot 18 is labelled charge and holds 7. What will Sprout say when it reads charge?

options.en: charge, the name on the cup

feedback.zh: 顺着名字 charge 找到 18 号杯，读出杯里存的值 7。
feedback.en: Follow the name charge to the cup at spot 18 and read its value, 7.
